# EV Charge Savings

> Calculate how much you'll save by switching to an EV. Live EIA electricity and gas rates for all 50 US states, 130+ EV models, EPA efficiency data. Free, no account needed. Built by a Kia EV9 owner.

## Core

- [Calculator](https://www.evchargesavings.com/): EV vs gas fuel cost calculator — pick any EV, pick your current gas car, choose your state, get annual and lifetime savings estimates using live government data.
- [How We Calculate](https://www.evchargesavings.com/how-we-calculate): Full methodology — EIA residential electricity rates, EIA weekly gas prices, EPA MPGe ratings, exact formulas used for every number on the site.
- [About](https://www.evchargesavings.com/about): Built by an engineering leader in the Pacific Northwest who owns a Kia EV9 and helped four coworkers buy one. Independent, not funded by any automaker or utility.

## For EV Owners

- [EV Owner Guide](https://www.evchargesavings.com/ev-owner): Level 2 home charging setup, time-of-use electricity rate switching, public charging network comparison, EV insurance review. For people who already own an EV.
- [EV Insurance](https://www.evchargesavings.com/ev-insurance): EVs cost 15–22% more to insure than comparable gas cars. Why it costs more, what affects rates, and how to reduce premiums.

## Guides

- [Is an EV Right For You?](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/is-ev-right-for-you): Decision framework — driving patterns, home charging access, total cost math.
- [EV Tax Credit 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/ev-tax-credit-7500): Federal $7,500 EV credit expired Oct 1, 2025. What state credits remain.
- [Home Charging Setup](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/home-charging-setup): Level 1 vs Level 2 charging, electrician costs, what you actually need.
- [Time-of-Use Electricity Rates](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/time-of-use-rates): How TOU plans cut overnight charging costs 30–60%.
- [EV vs Hybrid](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/ev-vs-hybrid): When a hybrid makes more sense than a full EV.
- [Best Home EV Chargers 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-home-ev-chargers-2026): Top Level 2 charger picks with specs and prices.
- [EV Charging Cost Per Mile](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/ev-charging-cost-per-mile): Formula and state-by-state cost breakdown.
- [EV vs Gas True Cost](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/ev-vs-gas-true-cost): Full ownership cost comparison including fuel, insurance, maintenance, depreciation.
- [EV Total Cost of Ownership](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/ev-total-cost-ownership): 5-year TCO analysis methodology.
- [Best Electric SUVs 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-electric-suv-2026): Ioniq 5, Equinox EV, EV9, Rivian R1S, Model Y — ranked by range, value, and charging.
- [Fastest Charging Electric SUVs 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/fastest-charging-electric-suvs-2026): 800V vs 400V architecture compared — which SUVs add the most miles in 15 minutes.
- [Best Electric Trucks 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-electric-trucks-2026): F-150 Lightning, Rivian R1T, Silverado EV, Ram REV, Cybertruck compared on payload and towing.
- [Best Electric Fleet Trucks 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-electric-fleet-trucks-2026): TCO guide for commercial buyers — fuel savings, depot charging, payload specs.
- [Best Electric Sedans 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-electric-sedans-2026): Tesla Model 3, Ioniq 6, BMW i4, Polestar 2 compared on range, charging, and interior.
- [Best EVs Under $40K 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-ev-under-40k-2026): Equinox EV, Bolt EUV, Kona Electric, Ariya — affordable EVs that don't compromise on range.
- [Best EV Insurance Companies 2026](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides/best-ev-insurance-companies-2026): Which carriers price EVs fairly, EV-specific discounts, gap insurance, and telematics programs.
- [All Guides](https://www.evchargesavings.com/guides): Full index — buying, charging, ownership, savings, finance.

## Data Pages

- [EV Savings by State](https://www.evchargesavings.com/ev-cost/california): Per-state EV charging cost and annual savings pages for all 50 states (e.g. /ev-cost/california, /ev-cost/texas).
- [Cost to Charge by Model + State](https://www.evchargesavings.com/cost-to-charge/tesla-model-y-long-range-awd/california): Per-model, per-state charging cost pages for top EVs (e.g. /cost-to-charge/tesla-model-y-long-range-awd/california).

## Optional
